en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Ali Bin Al Hassan, fro mAli Bin Rabaat, from Ubeydullah Bin Salih, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I said to himasws, ‘A female performer of Tumatto performs Tawaaf, then menstruates?’ Heasws said: ‘She should perform Sa’ee between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, and she would fulfil her Tumatto’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from Ali ibn al-Hassan from Ali ibn Ribat from ‘Ubayd Allah ibn Salih who has said the following:

“I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a woman, who is for al-Hajj al- Tamattu‘ (advantageous), performs Tawaf, then experiences Hayd (menses). He (the Imam) said, ‘She must perform Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah and perform Qada’ (compensatory Hajj for) her al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous).”’
